_comment: Tier-2: ThermalDEM requires DEMApplication as its base. Pitfall (kratos.thermal_dem #0). NOTE ON THE WRITTEN SIGNAL: this claim carries one of the five shared boilerplate Signal suffixes used across the Kratos catalog, which does not describe what actually happens. The real signal is recorded below and in the fixture output. Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). DEMApplication imports; ThermalDEMApplication does not (no wheel at any version). The base being present while the derived application is absent locates the obstacle — a reader who reads the boilerplate Signal ('solver reports Convergence is not achieved') would look for a solver problem that cannot arise, since nothing can be constructed in the first place. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
